text:
People Ops: Announcing parental leave top-up + childcare subsidy pilot. Effective July 1: eligible parents get a 6-week company top-up that supplements statutory pay (US/UK) to reach 100% base salary, plus a 3-month childcare subsidy of $500/month after return. Pilot open to parents returning between Jul 1 and Dec 31. Full policy + eligibility matrix: https://intranet.redwood.ai/policies/parental-topup :heart:

Maya (HR Lead): This covers birth parents, non-birth/secondary parents, adoptive parents, and guardians. Part-time employees are eligible; top-up prorates by FTE. We9ll publish examples for common scenarios in the doc. Town hall Fri 10:00 PT to walk through use cases.

Ajay (Payroll): Notes for processing: top-ups tagged as `benefit.parental_topup` and subsidy as `benefit.childcare_sub`. Payroll needs approved leave start date at least one pay-period before processing; retro pays will be handled but may delay timing. API example for benefit export:```bash
curl -X POST https://payroll.redwood.ai/v1/benefits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PAY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"user":"kate","benefit":"parental_topup","amount_cents":350000,"start":"2026-07-12"}'
```

Kate (Eng): Are breastfeeding/expressing accommodations covered under the subsidy or separate? Also, what about flexible RTW ramping?

Maya (HR Lead): Lactation accommodations are separate and remain covered under our accommodations policy. The subsidy is explicitly for external childcare costs; internal accommodations or phased RTW requests go through existing staggered RTW flows (see flexible-pto doc).

Lina (Legal): Reminder: country-specific tax implications vary. For EU/UK we9ll net-report per local rules; in the US this subsidy is taxable income — we9ll include gross-up options for a limited set of roles. Also ensure immigration/visa constraints are checked for international employees receiving cash subsidies.

Tom (People Ops): Audit logs will record: request_id, user, benefit_type, amount_cents, approver, timestamp, and tax_country. Example log line: `req=pt-2419003456 user=kate benefit=childcare_sub amount=50000 approver=maya ts=2419003501 country=US`

Ajay (Payroll): One more: managers must approve the return-to-work date in the system to trigger subsidy enrollment. People Ops will send a manager digest of pending enrollments daily.

calendar-bot: Reminder: Parental leave town hall Fri 10:00 PT, All-Hands room + Zoom.

Kate (Eng): Thanks 1: will join the town hall.

People Ops: Pilot opt-in form and FAQ posted on the intranet link. If you have cross-border cases (expat, visa-dependent families), DM People Ops and Legal. Thanks!
